trigger_condition: Only consider if preregistered Phase4B broad-category GDELT screen fails or is inconclusive. A Phase4B pass blocks opportunistic replacement.
objective: Test whether language- and session-specific Japanese-market news improves volatility/state forecasts without turning broad sentiment into an always-on directional alpha.

evidence.paper: When news travels: The role of sentiment in CME Nikkei futures returns
evidence.implication: Separate Japanese-language fundamental sentiment from English-language/local sentiment and respect trading-session context.

evidence.paper: How does news sentiment affect the states of Japanese stock return volatility?
evidence.implication: Macro-economic news occurrence/sentiment is a volatility-state candidate rather than automatically a directional-return signal.

evidence.paper: Investment with New Sentiment Analysis in Japanese Stock Market: Expert knowledge can still outperform ChatGPT
evidence.implication: Market-aware Japanese sentiment lexicons are a separate future family; if ever tested they require strict rolling/cross-fitted construction to avoid return leakage.

source_candidate.raw_storage: Do not archive article bodies; store only derived daily/session features and provenance.

semantic_groups.JAPAN_EQUITY: Nikkei 225 / Japanese stocks / Tokyo stock market

timing.true_jnu_future: When approved JNU intraday data exists, preregister Japan cash vs OSE night/US-session states before any session-specific test.

statistics.baseline: Same frozen volatility baseline used by Phase4B unless a new baseline is preregistered before data inspection.
statistics.bootstrap: 5-day block bootstrap, 2000 samples, fixed seed 42 unless independently preregistered otherwise.
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the four language x semantic cells.
statistics.recent_gate: Recent-window QLIKE and MSE must not reverse.

forbidden: Rewrite keywords after seeing a failed cell.
Merge Japanese and English only when convenient.
Use return-trained polarity scores on the same observations used for evaluation.
Promote a volatility-state pass into directional trading without a new preregistration.
Add more languages, themes, or half-lives after observing results.
